page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s throughout. Final printed j and i in "alijs", "Blasij", "Arsenij" and "Ioannicij" were read as vowels and written i. Printed "Iudæos", "Ioannicium" and "Iosephum" were written with J as consonant. The page ends with the hyphenated word "Constan-", which continues on the next page. Some ink smudges at the lower edge are not text.
